what: A reading of the 21 CONTROL affirmations of the main control run (results/expertise_control.json), made 2026-11-23 from the cached evidence strings. It is a judgement, not a label: it was made by the AI coding assistant under the author's direction and has not been independently re-read. No model score, no name. Categories: broad_label = the topic label is generic enough that the evidence supports a loose match; plausible_same_person = the evidence describes work in the topic attributed to a same-name person or the same institution that is not in the author's OpenAlex works list, so it could be a split profile, a homonym or a classifier gap; unsupported_or_other_person = the evidence names a different person, has no author, or does not support the topic.
